evidence_quotes.O: In the store, I could tell that the Bose Soundlink has more bass but the mids and highs were not as distinct as the Big Jambox.
evidence_quotes.C: We have owned the S95 for the past 2 years and really liked the camera but we wanted to get another camera as a backup
evidence_quotes.E: of course I get a lot of laughs at first but then you get the "oh that's pretty cool" look.
evidence_quotes.A: I also thought the user interface was incredibly easy. So easy that I am planning on getting one for my mom who has never used a computer.
evidence_quotes.N: When the camera extender arrived before our trip I was worried that it might fall apart with heavy use because it is basically an extendible pole.
